payments_paid_is_verified.name: payments_paid_is_verified
payments_paid_is_verified.value: "salon"."payments"."status" <> 'paid' or ("salon"."payments"."paid_at" is not null and "salon"."payments"."verified_by" is not null)

special_days_hours.name: special_days_hours
special_days_hours.value: "salon"."special_days"."kind" = 'closed' or ("salon"."special_days"."opens_at" is not null and "salon"."special_days"."closes_at" is not null and "salon"."special_days"."opens_at" < "salon"."special_days"."closes_at")
